title: 1990-91 O-Pee-Chee Wayne Gretzky #120 Los Angeles LA Kings PP Grading 8
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 1990-91 O-Pee-Chee Wayne Gretzky trading card is a must-have for any ice hockey fan. Featuring the Los Angeles Kings player in his prime, this card is a part of the National Hockey League (NHL) base set. The card number is 120 and it is a grade 8 PP card. 

The card is manufactured by O-Pee-Chee and is a sports trading card type. It is a part of the 1990-91 season set and is a great addition to any sports memorabilia collection. Get your hands on this rare piece of sports history today.
